notes.title: MAP2 release and additional information announcement!
notes.notes:
Map 2 has been unlocked...!
As planned, Map 2 was released on 3/30, but I've added additional elements, achievements, and hidden elements, so this will serve as the official announcement.
 
High-difficulty achievements have been added.
(If you have already cleared it, the achievements will be unlocked on the title screen. Rest assured.)
 
A hidden difficulty level has been added.

Soundtrack BGM update. Development materials have also been added to the artwork.
 
As previously announced, this update features a high-difficulty map where the position of your own unit is important.
 
I've adjusted it to be one of the most difficult games I've ever made in my life.
 
Destroying users with gratitude.
 
YuLu
(P.S I just realized that it was AimClimb's 3rd anniversary. It's an old game, but I'm glad I was able to double the amount of content. Look forward to the more casual AMNYAM too! There's a Demo on X. Soon, we'll release a limited-time Demo on Steam with multiplayer support and competitive mini-games. Stay tuned!)

notes.title: news and update
notes.notes:
Happy New Year! Have a good year. Announcement for Aim Climb.

Update

■ The appearance and color of the crosshair can now be changed.
■ A limit has been set on the number of button presses during aim misses. (It has almost no impact on normal play unless you continuously mash the button.)
■ Minor effects added.
■ Steam Cloud support.
■ Windowed mode.

That's all.
Aim Climb Map 2 will be released in late March. It will not be postponed unless I die.
I had been away from creation last year due to personal reasons, so I hope to release many games and other works this year. I am also thinking of uploading materials for games on X and possibly creating a simple browser game soon, so if you're interested, check it.  :)
X (Twitter) link: https://x.com/yulsugi


AM NYAM demo version will be released sometime in the future.

With gratitude to the users,
YuLu
↓ (P.S. I have finally created a Steam homepage. Other works will be added here.)
https://store.steampowered.com/developer/yulugame

notes.title: One year since release
notes.notes:
One year has passed since the release of Aim Climb.

I would like to thank once again all the players who have played Aim Climb.

Stay tuned for Map2 and other game releases!

Yul
